clue.text: Pupil I rebuke and let go

parts.note: a pupil is a learner, L as on a learner driver's plate
to rebuke someone is to berate them

explanation.surface: A teacher scolds a pupil and then sends them away.
explanation.definitionFit: To free someone is to release them, which is what letting them go means.

clue.text: Unprofitable bank

definitions.meaning: a ... year or ... time is one yielding little profit
an aircraft banks when it tilts, that is, inclines or tips to one side

explanation.definitionFit: Lean means meagre, as of a poor season, and also to tilt, as a plane does when banking.

clue.text: Playwright is out of public view

definitions.meaning: read literally, a dramatist sits back of the staged episodes he writes, out of sight of the audience
hidden from the public, working in private

explanation.walkthrough: The first reading is whimsical: the writer is literally positioned at the rear of his play's scenes.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom describes activity done privately, away from the audience or public gaze.

clue.text: Two islands are what constituted this old country

parts.note: Rhodes is a Greek island in the Aegean
I is the standard abbreviation for island
an are is a metric unit of area, abbreviated A

explanation.surface: A riddle about a former nation said to have been formed from two islands.
explanation.walkthrough: 'are' is not a link verb but the unit of land area (100 square metres), symbol A.
explanation.definitionFit: Rhodesia was the former name of the African nation now called Zimbabwe, so it is a defunct state.

clue.text: Criminal, one caught in the initiation of fraud

indicators.note: something caught in a trap is held inside it, so the numeral goes into the other letters

parts.note: one is I, the Roman numeral

indicators.note: the initiation of a thing is its start, so take its opening letter

explanation.surface: A crook is arrested at the very start of a swindle.
explanation.definitionFit: A thief is one kind of lawbreaker, a person who steals.

clue.text: Club together to hole the ball

definitions.meaning: to club together is to contribute jointly to a shared fund
in golf, a short lofted shot that drops straight into the cup

explanation.definitionFit: To contribute money alongside others is an idiom for pooling, and in golf a chipped shot that drops is holed.

clue.text: Solitary island, Italian

parts.note: Herm is one of the small Channel Islands, near Guernsey
It is short for Italian, as in It vermouth

explanation.surface: Someone alone on an island, an Italian perhaps.
explanation.definitionFit: A recluse who lives alone, so the noun stands for a solitary person.

clue.text: Snack stars eat without, at first, any noticeable starry lamentation

parts.note: the Plough is the constellation also called the Big Dipper

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so the chewing word goes round the initials

parts.note: to munch is to eat noisily

indicators.note: the first letters of the four following words are taken

explanation.surface: An astronomical lament about stars dining, quietly mournful.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' is used in its old sense of outside, so the eating word goes round the initials. A ploughman's lunch is a British pub meal of bread, cheese and pickle.
explanation.definitionFit: A ploughman's lunch is a light cold pub meal, so it is a kind of snack.

clue.text: New Yorker pans busybody

indicators.note: new suggests the letters given a fresh arrangement

explanation.surface: A critic from Manhattan's magazine slates a meddling person.
explanation.walkthrough: 'New Yorker' looks like the magazine, but 'New' is the anagram indicator acting on YORKER PANS.
explanation.definitionFit: A nosy parker is an informal British term for a meddler, someone prying into others' affairs.

clue.text: Plane it's acceptable to abandon

parts.note: a jet is an aircraft
'tis is the old contraction of it is
on means acceptable, as in that's not on

explanation.surface: An aircraft crew decide it is permissible to ditch something.
explanation.definitionFit: To jettison cargo is to throw it overboard, to discard or abandon it.

clue.text: Sex goddess has atrophied badly

indicators.note: badly implies the letters are put wrongly, so rearrange them

explanation.surface: A love deity has wasted away, poorly.
explanation.definitionFit: Aphrodite was the Greek deity of love and beauty, hence of sex.

clue.text: Searches for one's ancestry

definitions.meaning: to root about is to rummage or search
a person's origins or heritage, as in tracing family background

explanation.definitionFit: Roots means rummages, as a pig does, and also family origins or heritage.

clue.text: Joint cook needs to cover

indicators.note: the two words cover the answer, which sits concealed across them

explanation.surface: A chef is required to put a lid on something.
explanation.definitionFit: The knee is the hinge between thigh and shin, a joint of the leg.

clue.text: Framing, appropriate but pricier

parts.note: fitting means suitable or appropriate
prices that are up are higher

explanation.surface: A picture framer's work is suitable yet costly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Framing' looks like the picture framer's craft; it means setting someone up for a crime.
explanation.definitionFit: Fitting up is British slang for incriminating an innocent person falsely, i.e. framing them.

clue.text: Explosive fuel spy lit with malice aforethought

indicators.note: an explosion blows things apart, so the letters are scattered and reassembled

explanation.surface: A saboteur ignites volatile fuel in a premeditated act.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting out of spite means deliberately and maliciously, the sense of planned malice.

clue.text: Training is to impart national pride

indicators.note: training shapes and reorders something, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Education aims to instil love of one's homeland.
explanation.definitionFit: Love of and loyalty to one's own country is national pride.

clue.text: Painstakingly careful, despite being unrefined

parts.note: tho is an informal spelling of though, meaning despite that
rough means crude or unrefined

explanation.surface: Someone meticulous though coarse in manner.
explanation.definitionFit: Thorough work is complete and meticulous, done with great care.

clue.text: Ancient Mariner's tale about this chieftain

indicators.note: about here means turned round, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: Coleridge's poem is The Rime of the Ancient Mariner

explanation.surface: A seafaring story concerning a tribal leader.
explanation.definitionFit: An emir is a Muslim ruler or commander, a chief.

clue.text: Wine's hidden in instrument

indicators.note: something hidden is tucked inside, so the small word goes into the wine

parts.note: claret is red Bordeaux wine; the 's stands for has

explanation.surface: A bottle of wine has been stashed inside a musical instrument.
explanation.definitionFit: The clarinet is a single-reed woodwind instrument.

clue.text: Row about it after retirement

indicators.note: retirement is withdrawal or going back, so the letters are read backwards

parts.note: re means about or concerning

explanation.surface: An argument erupts over something once someone has stopped working.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Row' looks like a quarrel, but it means a line of seats.
explanation.definitionFit: A tier is one of a series of rows placed one above another.

clue.text: Console men played with in their sleep

indicators.note: played with suggests letters fiddled into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Gamers mess around with a video console even while dozing.
explanation.definitionFit: Somnolence is drowsiness, the state verging on slumber.

clue.text: Case not in position

indicators.note: not means the following small word is excluded from the synonym

parts.note: an instance is a case or example

explanation.surface: An argument that a container is not in place.
explanation.definitionFit: A stance is a posture or attitude, one's standing position.

clue.text: Flippant slant applied to promissory notes

parts.note: a facet is an aspect or angle on something, a slant
IOUs are written promises to pay debts

explanation.surface: A biased viewpoint is attached to IOU paper.
explanation.definitionFit: Facetious means treating serious matters with inappropriate humour, i.e. glib.

clue.text: For this reason black king is not moved

parts.note: so means therefore
B is the abbreviation for black, as on pencils
ER stands for Edwardus Rex, King Edward

explanation.surface: A chess remark: hence the dark monarch stays put.
explanation.walkthrough: The chess picture misleads; 'not moved' is emotional, unswayed by feeling.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone sober is calm and unemotional, unaffected or not stirred by feeling.

clue.text: Rock cake

definitions.meaning: to sway from side to side, as a ship does in a swell
a Swiss ... is a ... sponge cake

explanation.definitionFit: A ship rocks by pitching sideways, and a rolled sponge cake is also so named.

clue.text: American journalist habitually employed

parts.note: ED, for editor, is the usual crossword journalist

explanation.surface: A newspaperman from the States who is regularly in work.
explanation.definitionFit: Something regularly put to service is said to be used, worn by frequent use.

clue.text: More than one sheet (name given to rope)

indicators.note: the name is given to, i.e. added onto, the rope, so it follows it

parts.note: a line is a nautical rope

explanation.surface: A bracketed note about the label put on a cord, as on a sail.
explanation.definitionFit: Bed linen is a collective term for sheets and pillowcases, so several sheets.

clue.text: Pineapple chunk appears first — lose it

indicators.note: the chunk is said to come first, so it is placed before the fruit

parts.note: a gob is a lump or chunk
ananas is another name for the pineapple, as in French

explanation.surface: A piece of pineapple turns up first, and someone loses control.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pineapple' looks like the definition at the start, but it is wordplay, using the fruit's name in French and other languages.
explanation.definitionFit: To lose it is the slang idiom for going mad, flying into a fury.

clue.text: Sycophants with their leader taking refuge in republic

definitions.text: Sycophants with their leader taking refuge in republic

indicators.note: a refugee hides within, so the letter goes inside the country

parts.note: Yemen is a republic in Arabia

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: Fawning followers flee with their chief to an Arab state.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue reads as a whole: S, the head of 'Sycophants', shelters inside YEMEN.
explanation.definitionFit: Yes-men are toadies who agree with everything a boss says.

clue.text: Wife brought up in misery

parts.note: to bring up food is to vomit or retch

explanation.surface: A married woman raised in poverty.
explanation.definitionFit: To be wretched is to be in deep unhappiness, distressed.
